arxiv-1612-08154.title: Families of DFAs as Acceptors of ω \omega -Regular Languages \rsuper * Thanks: This research was supported by the United States - Israel Binational Science Foundation (BSF) grant 2016239 and the Israel Science Foundation (ISF) grant 1373/16.
arxiv-1612-08154.creator: Dana Angluin, Udi Boker, Dana Fisman
arxiv-1612-08154.description: Abstract . Families of dfa s ( fdfa s) provide an alternative formalism for recognizing ω \omega -regular languages. The motivation for introducing them was a desired correlation between the automaton states and right congruence relations, in a manner similar to the Myhill-Nerode theorem for regular languages.

arxiv-2012-03804.title: Common-spectrum process versus cross-correlation for gravitational-wave searches using pulsar timing arrays
arxiv-2012-03804.creator: Joseph D. Romano, Jeffrey S. Hazboun, Xavier Siemens, Anne M. Archibald
arxiv-2012-03804.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Joseph D. Romano, Jeffrey S. Hazboun, Xavier Siemens, Anne M. Archibald. The North American Nanohertz Observatory for Gravitational Waves (NANOGrav) has recently reported strong statistical evidence for a common-spectrum red-noise process for all pulsars, as seen in their 12.5-yr analysis for an isotropic stochastic gravitational-wave background. However, there is currently very little evidence for quadrupolar spatial correlations across the pulsars in the array, which is needed to make a confident claim of detection of a stochastic background.

arxiv-2110-10515.title: Planar Turán Number of Double Stars
arxiv-2110-10515.creator: Debarun Ghosh, Ervin Győri, Addisu Paulos, Chuanqi Xiao
arxiv-2110-10515.description: Abstract Given a graph F F , the planar Turán number of F F , denoted by ex 𝒫 ⁡ ( n , F ) \ex_{\mathcal{P}}(n,F) , is the maximum number of edges in an n n -vertex F F -free planar graph.

arxiv-2204-04046.title: KCD: Knowledge Walks and Textual Cues Enhanced Political Perspective Detection in News Media
arxiv-2204-04046.creator: Wenqian Zhang Shangbin Feng Zilong Chen, Zhenyu Lei Jundong Li Minnan Luo, School of Computer Science, Technology, Xi’an Jiaotong University, School of Science, Xi’an Jiaotong University, University of Virginia {2194510944,wind_binteng,luoyangczl,Fischer}@stu.xjtu.edu.cnjundong@virginia.edu minnluo@
arxiv-2204-04046.description: Abstract Political perspective detection has become an increasingly important task that can help combat echo chambers and political polarization. Previous approaches generally focus on leveraging textual content to identify stances, while they fail to reason with background knowledge or leverage the rich semantic and syntactic textual labels in news articles.

arxiv-2309-10568.title: Hierarchical Graph Modeling for Multi-Scale Optimization of Power Systems
arxiv-2309-10568.creator: David L. Cole 1 , Harsha Gangammanavar 2 , Victor M. Zavala 1 3
arxiv-2309-10568.description: Abstract Hierarchical optimization architectures are used in power systems to manage disturbances and phenomena that arise at multiple spatial and temporal scales. We present a graph modeling abstraction for representing such architectures and an implementation in the Julia package Plasmo.jl .

arxiv-2311-15986.title: On rank two theories with eight supercharges part II: Lefschetz pencils
arxiv-2311-15986.creator: Dan Xie
arxiv-2311-15986.description: Abstract The global Seiberg-Witten (SW) geometries for rank two theories with eight supercharges are studied. The theory is deformed generically so that there are only simplest I 1 I_{1} or I ~ 1 \tilde{I}_{1} singularities on the Coulomb branch, which geometrically gives the so-called Lefschetz pencils.

arxiv-2406-05773.title: Scalable and Generalizable Correspondence Pruning via Geometry-Consistent Pre-training
arxiv-2406-05773.creator: Tangfei Liao, Xiaoqin Zhang, Tao Wang, Hao Ye, Min Li, Guobao Xiao, Mang Ye
arxiv-2406-05773.description: Abstract Two-view correspondence pruning aims to identify reliable correspondences for camera pose estimation, serving as a fundamental step in many 3D vision tasks. Existing methods rely on geometric consistency to seek true correspondences (inliers) from numerous false correspondences (outliers). In this learning paradigm, outliers severely affect the representation learning of inliers, resulting in models that are neither robust nor generalizable.

arxiv-2410-11359.title: DODT: Enhanced Online Decision Transformer Learning through Dreamer’s Actor-Critic Trajectory Forecasting
arxiv-2410-11359.creator: Eric Hanchen Jiang, Zhi Zhang, Dinghuai Zhang, Andrew Lizarraga, Chenheng Xu, Yasi Zhang, Siyan Zhao, Zhengjie Xu, Peiyu Yu, Yuer Tang, Deqian Kong, Ying Nian Wu
arxiv-2410-11359.description: Abstract Advancements in reinforcement learning have led to the development of sophisticated models capable of learning complex decision-making tasks. However, efficiently integrating world models with decision transformers remains a challenge. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach that combines the Dreamer algorithm’s ability to generate anticipatory trajectories with the adaptive learning strengths of the Online Decision Transformer.

arxiv-2412-13144.title: Semi-Analytic Modeling of Dark Matter Subhalo Encounters with Thin Stellar Streams: Statistical Predictions for GD-1-like Streams in CDM
arxiv-2412-13144.creator: Duncan K. Adams, Aditya Parikh, Oren Slone, Rouven Essig, Manoj Kaplinghat, Adrian M. Price-Whelan
arxiv-2412-13144.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Duncan K. Adams, Aditya Parikh, Oren Slone, Rouven Essig, Manoj Kaplinghat, Adrian M. Price-Whelan. Stellar streams from disrupted globular clusters are dynamically cold structures that are sensitive to perturbations from dark matter subhalos, allowing them in principle to trace the dark matter substructure in the Milky Way. We model, within the context of Λ \Lambda CDM, the likelihood of dark matter subhalos to produce a significant feature in a GD-1-like stream and analyze the properties of such subhalos.

arxiv-2501-03423.title: SoK: A Review of Cross-Chain Bridge Hacks in 2023
arxiv-2501-03423.creator: Nikita Belenkov, Valerian Callens, Alexandr Murashkin, Kacper Bak, Martin Derka, Jan Gorzny, Sung-Shine Lee
arxiv-2501-03423.description: Abstract Blockchain technology has revolutionized industries by enabling secure and decentralized transactions. However, the isolated nature of blockchain ecosystems hinders the seamless transfer of digital assets across different chains. Cross-chain bridges have emerged as vital web3 infrastructure to address this challenge by facilitating interoperability between distinct blockchains. Cross-chain bridges remain vulnerable to various attacks despite sophisticated designs and security measures.

arxiv-2507-04730.title: CueLearner: Bootstrapping and local policy adaptation from relative feedback
arxiv-2507-04730.creator: Giulio Schiavi, Andrei Cramariuc, Lionel Ott, Roland Siegwart
arxiv-2507-04730.description: Abstract Human guidance has emerged as a powerful tool for enhancing reinforcement learning (RL). However, conventional forms of guidance such as demonstrations or binary scalar feedback can be challenging to collect or have low information content, motivating the exploration of other forms of human input. Among these, relative feedback (i.e.

arxiv-2601-19676.title: Optical steering of a large ring laser
arxiv-2601-19676.creator: Jannik Zenner, Karl Ulrich Schreiber, Simon Stellmer
arxiv-2601-19676.description: Abstract A common approach to reduce the linewidth of a laser is an increase of its resonator length. In large gas lasers, however, the frequency spacing between longitudinal modes of the resonator easily becomes significantly smaller than the Doppler-broadened width of the gain profile.

pmc-10532554.creator: Rene Castro, Elena Karulina, Nikolay Lapatin, Enrico Negro
pmc-10532554.description: Dielectric spectroscopy (frequency range f = 100…107 Hz and temperatures T = 293…403 K (accuracy 0.5 K), measuring voltage applied to the sample was 1.0 V) was used to study composite materials based on perfluorosulfonic membranes with inclusions of rare-earth elements, in particular, europium (III) and terbium (III) chlorides.

pmc-10573816.title: Ocular Surface Microbiota in Naïve Keratoconus: A Multicenter Validation Study
pmc-10573816.creator: Carlos Rocha-de-Lossada, Cosimo Mazzotta, Federico Gabrielli, Filomena Tiziana Papa, Carmen Gómez-Huertas, Celia García-López, Facundo Urbinati, Rahul Rachwani-Anil, María García-Lorente, José-María Sánchez-González, Miguel Rechichi, Giovanni Rubegni, Davide Borroni, Domenico Schiano-Lomoriello, Ann
pmc-10573816.description: In the field of Ophthalmology, the mNGS 16S rRNA sequencing method of studying the microbiota and ocular microbiome is gaining more and more weight in the scientific community. This study aims to characterize the ocular microbiota of patients diagnosed with keratoconus who have not undergone any prior surgical treatment using the mNGS 16S rRNA sequencing method.

pmc-11516926.title: Exploring the state-of-the-art on competencies for policymaking in public health
pmc-11516926.creator: L Frisina, E Aragón de León
pmc-11516926.description: Against the complex backdrop characterizing both the nature of public health challenges and the corresponding skills required to face them, this presentation will introduce the state-of-the-art on scholarship concerned with the definition and/or development of competencies for effective policy making in public health.

pmc-11691980.title: ROLE ENGAGEMENT IN VOLUNTEERING: IMPACTS ON SUBJECTIVE WELL-BEING AND COGNITION IN MIDDLE AND LATER LIFE
pmc-11691980.creator: Shiyu Lu
pmc-11691980.description: The existing literature predominantly emphasizes the quantitative aspect of volunteering, such as volunteer hours, overlooking the depth of role engagement and psychological dimensions of volunteer involvement and their impact on health. The study focused on the impacts of volunteer hours, role engagement, and engagement profiles on the well-being and health of midlife and older adults.

pmc-12457837.title: Protocol for Quantitative Estimation of Hydrogen Cyanide Production from Bacteria
pmc-12457837.creator: Devashish Pathak, Pushpendra Sharma, Venkadasamy Govindasamy, Archna Suman
pmc-12457837.description: Hydrogen cyanide (HCN) is a volatile, nitrogen-containing secondary metabolite produced by various bacterial species, primarily during the idiophase of growth under nutrient-limiting or competitive conditions. It plays a significant ecological role as a biocontrol agent by inhibiting the respiratory enzymes of plant pathogens and modulating microbial competition in the rhizosphere.

pmc-12610148.title: RSO-YOLO: A Real-Time Detector for Small and Occluded Objects in Autonomous Driving Scenarios
pmc-12610148.creator: Quanxiang Wang, Zhaofa Zhou, Zhili Zhang, Enrico Meli
pmc-12610148.description: In autonomous driving, detecting small and occluded objects remains a substantial challenge due to the complexity of real-world environments. To address this, we propose RSO-YOLO, an enhanced model based on YOLOv12. First, the bidirectional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) and space-to-depth convolution (SPD-Conv) replace the original neck network.
